Definition: from G3529; to subdue (literally or figuratively):--conquer, overcome, prevail, get the victory.
BiblicalUsage: To overcome is to be the stronger one in the fight. A stronger man overcomes the strong man and divides his spoils, Christ says He has overcome the world, God is justified and overcomes when He is judged, and the young men have overcome the wicked one.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe overcoming is Christ's gift before it is my effort: He has overcome the world, and in Him I overcome too. The young men have overcome the wicked one, and Christ has overcome the world — their victory is His, lent to them.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
